mentions.name: Gatana
mentions.description: An extensible and flexible agentic connectivity platform supporting MCP, OpenAPI/Swagger, and FaaS, with built-in CodeMode, compression, SIEM integration, access token forwarding, SCIM 2.0, on-demand agentic sandboxes (e.g. LangChain's "Deep Agents"), and an OpenAPI-to-MCP mapper.
mentions.audience: Organizations with more complex agentic setups
mentions.source_excerpt: Im working on an extensible and flexible agentic connectivity platform (MCP, OpenAPI/Swagger, FaaS) with niceties like built-in CodeMode, compression, SIEM integration, access token forwarding, SCIM 2.0, on-demand agentic sandboxes (e.g. LangChains "Deep Agents").
mentions.author: thecopy
